title: AI Code Assistants
description: Settings for every AI code assistant panel.
$comment: Generated from the provider registry by `jlpm generate:schema` - edit the provider descriptors, not this file.

presentationMode.title: Presentation mode
presentationMode.description: Label session rows by the session `name` (default) or the project `path`.

recentLimit.title: Recent items count
recentLimit.description: Number of sessions listed in the Recent section, sorted by last activity.

colouredTabs.title: Coloured terminal tabs
colouredTabs.description: Tint each assistant terminal's dock tab with its conversation's colour.

sidebar.title: Sidebar position
sidebar.description: Dock the assistant panels in the `left` or `right` (default) sidebar.

syncFileBrowser.title: Sync file browser with opened session
syncFileBrowser.description: Move the file browser to the project folder of each session you open.

providers.antigravity.dangerouslySkipPer.title: Antigravity: Dangerously skip permissions
providers.antigravity.dangerouslySkipPer.description: Launch new and resumed sessions with `--dangerously-skip-permissions`; tool calls run unasked.

providers.claude.dangerouslySkipPermissi.title: Claude Code: Dangerously skip permissions
providers.claude.dangerouslySkipPermissi.description: Launch new and resumed sessions with `--dangerously-skip-permissions`; tool calls run unasked.

providers.codex.dangerouslyBypassApprova.title: Codex: Bypass Codex approvals and sandbox
providers.codex.dangerouslyBypassApprova.description: Launch new and resumed sessions with `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox`; tool calls run unasked, outside the sandbox.

providers.copilot.yoloMode.title: Copilot: YOLO mode
providers.copilot.yoloMode.description: Launch new and resumed sessions with `--yolo`; tool calls, paths and URLs are allowed unasked.

providers.gemini.yoloMode.title: Gemini: YOLO mode
providers.gemini.yoloMode.description: Launch new and resumed sessions with `--yolo`; tool calls run unasked.

providers.kimi.yoloMode.title: Kimi: YOLO mode
providers.kimi.yoloMode.description: Launch new and resumed sessions with `--yolo`; regular tool calls run unasked.
